Population increased in South Kesteven

The estimated population of South Kesteven in 2024 was 147,151 usual residents, a rise of 0.7% since 2023.

This meant that South Kesteven's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of South Kesteven increased by 2.4%.

Over this slightly longer period, South Kesteven was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of South Kesteven

The average (median) age rose to 46.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of South Kesteven has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
South Kesteven is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, South Kesteven's population of 147,151 usual residents was made up of:

  • 25,438 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.3%)
  • 86,608 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.9%)
  • 35,105 people aged 65 years and over, (23.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, South Kesteven has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (23.9% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In South Kesteven, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in South Kesteven
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for South Kesteven, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 498 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 1,103 births and 1,601 deaths in South Kesteven.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,056 (0.7%). There were 8,480 people entering the area and 7,424 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in South Kesteven's population of 480 (0.3%) as a result of 840 people entering the area and 360 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for South Kesteven was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of South Kesteven in mid-2023 is 146,114.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 313 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 43 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 356 people.
